annotations.title: Backtest a Google Ads automated rule over past days

description: Backtest a Google Ads automated rule: what it WOULD have done on each of the last N days (1-30, default 7), replayed on Google's daily metrics with the same plan a live run makes. Pass ruleId (a saved rule) or rule (the body create_google_ads_rule takes, e.g. from list_ad_rule_templates) to try one before saving it. Nothing is changed. Budgets, bids and statuses are today's values, and caps are not carried from day to day. Read-only, free.

customerId.description: Google Ads account id, for an unsaved rule

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id, when the account is managed through one

rule.description: an unsaved rule: the body create_google_ads_rule takes
